0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.thesis: Agents can improve their own setup if every conversation is centralized with its tool calls and outputs, graded by LLM-as-judge scorers against team rubrics, and the failures are periodically handed to a self-improvement agent that proposes skill changes whose effect shows up in tracked scores.

11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.thesis: Because agents now open most pull requests and few teams review every line, a software factory can only move toward autonomy if every loop carries independent, layered automated verification (deterministic analysis, agentic review, supply-chain checks) plus agent-generated evidence that the work is correct.

18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.thesis: In welcoming the final keynote block, Ksenia Se observes that hiring is a main reason people attend and suggests attendees build an agent to rank speakers' companies and match their open roles, then talk to those people in person rather than auto-sending resumes.

1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.thesis: Troyanovsky argues that agents diffuse into real firms only when they are simple and reliable, which comes from encoding opinionated processes as behavior specs and supervising whether trajectories follow them, not just from outcome-based evals.

29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.thesis: Katz argues that models have absorbed the harness tricks that once added coding intelligence, but the harness is not dead: it opens each new frontier of tasks for the data flywheel and owns infrastructure, trust and efficiency that the model cannot absorb.

44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.thesis: At Apollo's structured-credit arm, AI becomes mission-critical only when it runs on the firm's own reconciled data with a validated golden source, which requires the vendor to sit with the teams and learn their workflows.

4add802c-6a68-4e9c-93fb-9c1e017193bc.thesis: Shaukat argues that agentic software factories, like Toyota's factories, must engineer confidence through clear intent, guide rails, independent verification and evidence, because human review, LLM judges and long agent runs cannot keep up with abundant AI-generated code.

4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.thesis: As implementation gets cheap and agents run longer unattended, the failure mode becomes product incoherence, so teams must carry intent, prior decisions, and ownership context from intake through implementation and review and distill human judgment back into the agents' context.

68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.thesis: Because frontier models now outpace adoption, financial firms should stop hand-building agents one by one and build a reusable five-layer foundation (MCP connectors, skills, identity and permissions, human approval, evals) that lets them scale agents safely.

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.thesis: GEICO's coding agents sped up the inner loop but major legacy modernization stayed bottlenecked on collaboration and context, so it built a multiplayer AI-native war room, steered by a Markdown fleet manager, that maps a legacy domain and ships an agent-callable API in a day.

736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.thesis: AI writing slop does not go away as models scale, so Towards AI built a voice-matching creative-writing benchmark with multiple drafts and cross-family LLM judges, and found the practical goal is the model least annoying to edit, not a perfect one-shot.

73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.thesis: Two Sigma gives agents real autonomy safely by composing lightweight controls — an agent registry, risk-tiered review, declared tool entitlements enforced at runtime, shared evals, and classifier-gated approvals — instead of locking everything down or relying on policy documents.

871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.thesis: Because frontier models are commoditizing, labs must recoup trillion-dollar bets by locking businesses in at the agent layer or competing with them directly, so companies should build their agentic systems on open foundations like Hermes Agent that they own and control.

8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.thesis: Despite a flood of agent payment protocols, agents barely pay because friction at every stage of the funnel (need, setup, discovery and trust, pay-per-use billing) suppresses demand, and that friction is only now starting to clear.

8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.thesis: Agent frameworks that agree on almost nothing all converge on running code in a separate sandboxed computer, so builders should commit to that execution boundary first and treat the framework as a swappable choice.

9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.thesis: A hedge fund can be engineered as a function from external and internal context to a stock/size/timing decision, decomposed into steps whose runners (code, statistics, LLMs, people) and settings are tuned like hyperparameters against an evaluable north star.

a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.thesis: Bridgewater argues that AI only becomes useful for investing when it sits on a governed, ontology-aligned corpus of internal and external unstructured data, served to both humans and agents and wired into investors' existing habits so their work compounds.

af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.thesis: Valenzuela argues that scaling next-frame video prediction turns video models into real-time, interactive world simulators that learn physics on their own and could eventually render any interface, operating system, or agent's visual reasoning.

b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.thesis: The AI engineer's job has moved from writing features to building the always-on loop (traces, evals, agents reading telemetry, fixes) that improves the product, with evaluator alignment to human judgment as the core skill.

b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.thesis: Agents are now the main web searchers, and Exa Snapshot's dated versions of the web let teams backtest search-driven financial models and agents without future information leaking in, while checking that features generalize.

bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.thesis: A naive prompt-a-model-on-the-diff review agent misses bugs, lacks context, costs too much and nitpicks, so a good one needs historical-bug evals, a different model than the author, a living codebase wiki, sandboxed end-to-end testing and per-subtask model selection.

c34c075b-c695-4227-bf8e-3b4eeb3460d9.thesis: Enterprise AI faces a steep diffusion gap: nearly all large firms have rolled out a general-purpose LLM, but agents in non-engineering work remain at about five percent.

c4ba0138-6f6d-4780-93a1-4d8f0c478339.thesis: When an enterprise agent task has no benchmark and little expert access, start from a known answer (a source page, a rule, a template clause) and generate the input around it, so evaluation becomes automatic and iteration speeds up.

c901e963-5be9-4a1d-86a3-d9354374bbcd.thesis: Cutting an AI bill starts with measuring token spend per team and use case, then right-sizing models and tokens-per-second to each workload, buying capacity against the base load, and judging tokens by outcomes rather than usage.

cada670e-c5ea-4977-b3c2-9a68dda26abb.thesis: General Intuition bets that scaling action-labeled gameplay video from Medal into pixels-in, actions-out models will produce general agents that act in real time across games, computers and robots, the way scaling code produced coding agents.

caecd5f6-b352-4868-a995-f0f71679caf0.thesis: Even though frontier models keep getting cheaper and better, Ramp argues it pays to do applied research now (specialist post-trained models, KV-cache cartridges, agent swarms) to cut latency and token cost rather than waiting for the labs.

dd25c0a8-d64f-4d6e-a597-7dd576eabc16.thesis: The day-one close recaps the final keynotes and urges attendees to use the talks as a starting point for conversations with each other.

edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.thesis: Agents can only be trusted to finish work without humans reading every line when each task carries a deterministic, app-specific verification loop that proves the outcome with evidence and feeds failures back to the agent.

ee927042-2ba1-44c3-b304-d001ae247839.thesis: Trusting agents in regulated workflows starts by treating written policy as the institution's original intent, separating it from the constantly changing running system, and placing agents inside gated workflow graphs that keep required checks.

f7204e6d-a47c-4535-804e-16b4db579b95.thesis: Carson argues that engineers should stop coding locally and instead manage fleets of cloud agent sessions, with builder, reviewer, QA, manager and merge agents escalating to a human who must personally verify feature videos, and should hire for agent-operating skill.

fca86857-d079-46a6-94a7-62b0bb8e5d31.thesis: Teams serving open models with vLLM mostly guess at configuration, so a live benchmarking harness (Runpod's Benchpod) that lets them change knobs quickly and measure TTFT, inter-token latency and throughput under realistic concurrency is how to get from R&D to production.

0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.section: ### 00:00:00 — Why Agents Repeat Mistakes Across Sessions
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.quote: you got the transcript of what was said, you've got the tool calls that show what the agent did, and then you have the output
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.claim: Self-improvement needs the whole team's agent traces centralized, including transcripts, tool and MCP calls, and resulting diffs, which shared cloud runners provide for free.
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.speaker: Ben Holmes

0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.section: ### 00:00:00 — Why Agents Repeat Mistakes Across Sessions
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.quote: It's the idea that you can have agents review their past conversations.
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.claim: The improvement loop is to have agents review past conversations, score them, find failures and their causes, and propose fixes to skills and configuration.
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.speaker: Ben Holmes

0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.section: ### 00:06:36 — A Meta-Skill for Mining Past Runs & Updating Skills
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.quote: Where you can define what thing you're trying to score with an LLM as a judge.
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.claim: Scorers are short markdown rubrics (redundant tests, verbosity, efficiency) with pass/fail thresholds that an LLM judge applies to each conversation, typically when a PR merges.
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.speaker: Ben Holmes

0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.section: ### 00:06:36 — A Meta-Skill for Mining Past Runs & Updating Skills
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.quote: these AIs are very persistent and will work around whatever roadblock that they run into, and they won't tell you about it
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.claim: Agents silently work around stale instructions and failed tool calls, so efficiency scoring over traces surfaces setup problems humans never see.
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.speaker: Ben Holmes
also_at: ### 00:12:52 — Evaluating Self-Improving Agent Loops at Warp

0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.section: ### 00:12:52 — Evaluating Self-Improving Agent Loops at Warp
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.quote: And then maybe on a cron job every 24 hours, go through a sampling of the past 24 hours of conversations.
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.claim: A scheduled self-improvement agent takes the failing reports, finds commonalities, and opens PRs against the skills repository.
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.speaker: Ben Holmes

0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.section: ### 00:12:52 — Evaluating Self-Improving Agent Loops at Warp
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.quote: the one part that's kind of missing from that is it's very invisible what the agent actually decided
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.claim: Unlike memory or 'dreaming' approaches, tracking scores over time makes self-improvement visible and lets you attribute score changes to specific merged skill edits.
0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.speaker: Ben Holmes

11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.section: ### 00:00:00 — The Code Review Bottleneck in AI Software Factories
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.quote: If you have merged pull requests and reviewed every line of code that was merged. I do see a few people.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.claim: Nearly everyone's coding agents now open pull requests, but only a few people review every merged line, and that gap is the problem the talk addresses.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.speaker: Manish Kapur

11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.section: ### 00:00:00 — The Code Review Bottleneck in AI Software Factories
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.quote: You need to give your agents a way to verify that the work is correct.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.claim: With code generation largely solved, the highest-value work is building checks (tests, benchmarks) that let agents verify their own output.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.speaker: Addy Osmani

11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.section: ### 00:06:32 — Multi-Layered Verification: Static Analysis, Tests & Agent Critics
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.quote: you want to get to a place where the AI is giving you as much verification evidence as possible
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.claim: Agents should exercise changes like a real user (browser tests, screenshots, videos) and hand humans verification evidence rather than asking them to read diffs.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.speaker: Addy Osmani

11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.section: ### 00:06:32 — Multi-Layered Verification: Static Analysis, Tests & Agent Critics
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.quote: We absolutely 100% believe that each company should adopt a zero trust multi-layered verification approach.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.claim: Verification should be zero-trust and run inside every loop: the agentic loop, CI, and code maintenance.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.speaker: Manish Kapur
also_at: ### 00:12:37 — Scaling Trusted Autonomy with Sonar & Anthropic

11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.section: ### 00:12:37 — Scaling Trusted Autonomy with Sonar & Anthropic
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.quote: I personally think it's fine for the code to be written, labeled as being coming from an agent.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.claim: Agent-written code should be labeled in the PR because it signals which extra checks apply and preserves auditability, while a human still owns the outcome.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.speaker: Addy Osmani

11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.section: ### 00:12:37 — Scaling Trusted Autonomy with Sonar & Anthropic
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.quote: it's a layered approach where each layer is tuned and optimized
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.claim: Each verification layer targets a different risk: deterministic analysis for bugs and security flaws, agentic review for logic and intent, and a supply-chain layer for CVEs and malicious packages.
11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.speaker: Manish Kapur

18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.quote: And what I've noticed is that one of the strongest incentives to come to this conference is hiring.
18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.claim: Hiring, for both companies and speakers, is one of the strongest reasons people come to the conference.
18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.speaker: Ksenia Se

18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.quote: So I suggest you build an agent. That takes the conference program and makes a list of all the speakers and their companies.
18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.claim: Attendees can build an agent that ranks speakers' companies, matches open roles and compensation, and lets them update their preferences on the evidence.
18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.speaker: Ksenia Se

18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.quote: And please don't make your agents send out your resume automatically.
18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.claim: The agent should inform in-person conversations with the people whose work you liked, not automate applications.
18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.speaker: Ksenia Se

1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.quote: The first problem is that there is a competency gap because agents, as you think of them as you think of them today, they outsource the complexity to the user.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.claim: Coding-style agent products fail to raise enterprise productivity because they push skill, memory and process design onto users, creating a competency gap and a process gap.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.speaker: Mitchell Troyanovsky

1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.quote: It doesn't happen through deterministic systems, right? People are not deterministic; they're intelligent entities. And instead, there are processes that are put in place
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.claim: Organizations already trust non-deterministic workers at scale by imposing processes, and agents should be made trustworthy the same way.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.speaker: Mitchell Troyanovsky

1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.quote: then you can also use them as a rubric. And you can say, in this particular trajectory, whether that is in any trajectory that doesn't have a ground truth.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.claim: Behavior specs double as rubrics that can grade any trajectory, even without ground truth, scaling supervision signal far beyond outcome-based evals.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.speaker: Mitchell Troyanovsky

1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.quote: Right not because the process it did was bad, but because the process it did was not opinionated.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.claim: Agents given open-ended tasks produce inconsistent results because their process is unopinionated; builders must encode opinions about how the work is done.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.speaker: Mitchell Troyanovsky

1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.quote: They want it done reliably at scale in a way that they can trust, and in a way that their people know how to work with
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.claim: Customers value reliable, consistent work over agents finding novel 'better' approaches, so predictability beats creativity for scaling output.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.speaker: Mitchell Troyanovsky

1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.quote: Ask the coding agent to make a subagent that pretends to be your production agent.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.claim: Forking a trajectory at the failing decision, or cheaply simulating the production agent with a subagent, lets builders diagnose and fix behavior failures quickly.
1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.speaker: Mitchell Troyanovsky

29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.section: ### 00:00:00 — Evolution of the Coding Agent Harness
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.quote: It turns out the harness. Is actually making itself obsolete through what I call the data flywheel.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.claim: The harness makes itself obsolete through a data flywheel: it brings harder tasks within reach, users generate data, and models learn those skills natively.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.speaker: Jediah Katz

29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.section: ### 00:00:00 — Evolution of the Coding Agent Harness
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.quote: A fancy harness in this day and age no longer adds coding intelligence.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.claim: Studies show the choice of harness barely changes coding eval scores for newer models, so harness scaffolding no longer adds coding intelligence.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.speaker: Jediah Katz

29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.section: ### 00:06:36 — What Happens as Models Absorb Harness Scaffolding
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.quote: There are some parts of the harness that the model can't absorb.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.claim: Infrastructure for long-running cloud agents, trust and security controls, and cost efficiency remain harness responsibilities the model cannot absorb.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.speaker: Jediah Katz

29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.section: ### 00:06:36 — What Happens as Models Absorb Harness Scaffolding
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.quote: It's actually the harness which unlocks. A new frontier for the model to then solve, and kicks off that flywheel again.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.claim: Once a capability like coding is commoditized, the harness opens the next frontier of tasks (knowledge work, software factories) and restarts the flywheel.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.speaker: Jediah Katz

29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.section: ### 00:06:36 — What Happens as Models Absorb Harness Scaffolding
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.quote: Curiously, in Grokbot, we've actually found ourselves putting back a lot of these things, adding new prompting, adding new guardrails.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.claim: In new domains like an autonomous colleague product, the team is re-adding prompting and guardrails because models have not yet mastered those tasks.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.speaker: Jediah Katz

29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.quote: whenever a shim stops firing. That model or that agent will put up a PR and say this shim can be cleaned up.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.claim: Harnesses should be designed to ship and unship features easily, for example by logging deterministic shims and having an agent remove ones that stop firing.
29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.speaker: Jediah Katz

44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.section: ### 00:00:00 — Rowspace & Apollo: AI for Institutional Investment Data
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.quote: now all of that is automated, and then from our team's perspective, we are just QAing that and checking it each day to make sure that looks right.
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.claim: A weekly manual trade reconciliation built from bank statements became a repeatable automated report the team only QAs.
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.speaker: Jack McDonald

44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.section: ### 00:00:00 — Rowspace & Apollo: AI for Institutional Investment Data
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.quote: that allows these PMS to kind of build something to call it eighty, ninety percent completion, and then kind of use their judgment and their thought to further refine that portfolio
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.claim: Portfolio construction that took a PM two to three days in Excel now takes minutes to reach 80-90%, leaving the last stretch to the manager's judgment.
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.speaker: Jack McDonald

44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.section: ### 00:06:34 — Reconciling Fragmented Deal & Portfolio Data with Agents
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.quote: it's all general information that that's being worked off of, and none of your own actual data.
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.claim: General-purpose LLMs help with research but cannot carry trading decisions, because trust comes from owning your data with a platform on top of it.
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.speaker: Jack McDonald

44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.section: ### 00:06:34 — Reconciling Fragmented Deal & Portfolio Data with Agents
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.quote: I still think it's very early.
44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.claim: Finance, especially asset management and institutional banking, is still early in AI adoption, with today's research and model-building uses being lower value.

4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.section: ### 00:00:00 — Why Coding Agents Fail Without Product & Issue Context
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.quote: Kind of moves out of that inner loop and largely into the outer loop.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.claim: Because agents now run for hours or days without humans steering them, context has to be managed by systems in the outer loop rather than supplied interactively.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.speaker: Tom Moor

4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.section: ### 00:00:00 — Why Coding Agents Fail Without Product & Issue Context
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.quote: Code is not the bottleneck now. Implementation is not the bottleneck now. The failure mode here isn't an inability to build.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.claim: With cheap code, the real risk is losing coherence: shipping features that don't make sense as a whole product.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.speaker: Tom Moor

4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.section: ### 00:06:57 — Structuring Context Graphs & Specs at Linear
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.quote: This is just like a really great starting point for your covering agent at this point. It massively increases the chances of success.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.claim: A triage agent that enriches each issue with customer data, logs, reproductions, and related past decisions gives the coding agent a base context that sharply raises success rates.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.speaker: Tom Moor

4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.section: ### 00:06:57 — Structuring Context Graphs & Specs at Linear
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.quote: They can still miss a lot of the context behind it.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.claim: Agents that read the code still miss intent, earlier decisions and trade-offs, visual expectations, parallel work, owners, and recent risks such as reverts.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.speaker: Tom Moor

4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.section: ### 00:14:17 — Human-Agent Collaboration in the Issue Tracker
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.quote: so now we're thinking like less about is this code correct and more about is this the right change for the product?
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.claim: A context-aware review agent pulls in original intent, product history, conflicting work, and ownership so review catches product-level mistakes a code-only reviewer would miss.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.speaker: Tom Moor

4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.section: ### 00:14:17 — Human-Agent Collaboration in the Issue Tracker
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.quote: Extract learnings, and then inject them back into the codebase.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.claim: A daily automation distills review corrections and reverts into agents.md and docs so human judgment compounds instead of being repeated.
4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.speaker: Tom Moor

68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.section: ### 00:00:11 — Introduction: Frontier AI in Financial Services
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.quote: And our opportunity here is scale. Is not the model. Our opportunity here is scale.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.claim: Model capability is no longer the constraint in financial services; the opportunity is building a foundation that takes agents from one-by-one builds to many.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.speaker: Belinda Neal

68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.quote: We want it to just propose new amendments to our owner's data. Not actually make those amendments
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.claim: The trust layer scopes agents with an identity and least-privilege permissions and has them propose actions that a human approves before anything changes.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.speaker: Keon Shahab

68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.quote: we think about skills. As living, breathing, versioned code, essentially, even though they're just plain text.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.claim: Business rules and processes from subject-matter experts should be encoded as skills and maintained like frequently updated, versioned code.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.speaker: Keon Shahab

68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.quote: You'll want to have those agents work on one secure connectivity layer which is MCP.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.claim: Hand-wiring each agent to each source system does not scale, so agents should reach business data through a single secure MCP connectivity layer.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.speaker: Keon Shahab

68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.quote: Is that the business is now becoming closer to engineering
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.claim: In the new operating model, business users correct and propose changes to agents directly, and engineering reviews, tests, and ships them as skill changes.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.speaker: Keon Shahab

68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.quote: To any variable, you'll be able to determine whether that variable change actually improved.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.claim: SME-defined eval suites with a baseline are what tell you whether a new model or skill change improved the agent or caused a regression.
68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.speaker: Keon Shahab

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.speaker: Ford Prior

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.speaker: Ford Prior

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.section: ### 00:06:39 — Inside the Fable War Room: Multi-Agent Incident Response

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.claim: Across three legacy claims domains the one-day war room experiments delivered concrete outcomes, from an extended rentals API to a vetted salvage migration plan that also surfaced a production bug.
6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.speaker: Ford Prior

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.section: ### 00:06:39 — Inside the Fable War Room: Multi-Agent Incident Response

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.claim: A Markdown fleet manager that breaks down a goal, dispatches researchers, queues work for human approval and then dispatches builders makes expensive agent fleets steerable.

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.speaker: Ford Prior

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.speaker: Ford Prior

736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.section: ### 00:00:00 — Defining AI Writing Slop & Why It Happens
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.quote: Endlessly, the worst to me is that it usually has the wrong tone, or at least it has no tone and like everyone's tone at the same time
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.claim: Slop is more than overused words: it is generic, says nothing, repeats, hallucinates, and above all lacks a distinctive voice.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.speaker: Louis-François Bouchard

736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.section: ### 00:00:00 — Defining AI Writing Slop & Why It Happens
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.quote: It just Keeps on scaling, so we need something different than just training the models more.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.claim: Slop persists as models improve, so fixing it requires measurement rather than just more training.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.speaker: Louis-François Bouchard

736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.section: ### 00:06:12 — Constructing a Benchmark for Creative Writing
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.quote: why do we generate the five scripts? Is To check for intra-model variability
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.claim: Generating five drafts per task measures intra-model variance, which grows as model quality drops and hides outlier generations.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.speaker: Louis-François Bouchard

736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.section: ### 00:06:12 — Constructing a Benchmark for Creative Writing
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.quote: the problem with AI judges is that. They have references. Some models prefer themselves.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.claim: LLM judges favor their own model family, so judging must use a different family and be spot-checked with human pairwise comparisons.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.speaker: Louis-François Bouchard

736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.quote: You just want to find a model that will be the least annoying to you.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.claim: For creative writing the right choice is the model that gets you to your target with the least friction, since no model one-shots good prose.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.speaker: Louis-François Bouchard

736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.quote: What I suggest is to generate several drafts.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.claim: At scale, many cheap drafts merged by a stronger high-thinking model beat a single expensive generation, with a long detailed prompt and human review still required.
736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.speaker: Louis-François Bouchard

73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.section: ### 00:00:00 — Balancing Innovation Speed and Institutional Trust
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.quote: So the three approvers who were supposed to approve that looked at it and said, "Yep, that's the right thing that's supposed to happen."
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.claim: The Citibank–Revlon payment error shows that procedures, warnings and human approvers can all be in place and still fail, which is the failure mode agent controls must anticipate.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.speaker: John Feminella

73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.section: ### 00:00:00 — Balancing Innovation Speed and Institutional Trust
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.quote: We allow them a certain amount of autonomy, along with a certain amount of control.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.claim: Agents, like humans, are non-deterministic, so the answer is bounded autonomy with visibility and controls rather than lockdown, making safety and innovation compatible.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.speaker: John Feminella

73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.section: ### 00:06:21 — Risk Taxonomies & Guardrails for AI Agents
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.quote: So the agent registry makes agents legible, and it registers which reviews and discovers the key facts about agents.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.claim: An automatic agent registry recording owner, tools and endpoints makes scattered agents legible so the firm can govern and reuse them without an onerous pre-approval gate.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.speaker: John Feminella

73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.section: ### 00:06:21 — Risk Taxonomies & Guardrails for AI Agents
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.quote: Again, that feels safe, but now we've got a trivial summarizer waiting two months for the same sign-offs as an agent-based captioning production system.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.claim: Applying one heavy review process to every agent starves high-risk reviews and stalls low-risk experiments, so review should be tiered by each agent's risk.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.speaker: John Feminella

73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.quote: Clear their purpose upfront, and say what tools they're going to use, or what tools.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.claim: Instead of a blanket allow-list, agents declare their purpose and tools up front and the runtime enforces that policy from the registry at initialization.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.speaker: John Feminella

73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.quote: When explicit rules apply, we want deterministic fast paths.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.claim: Human approval of every agent action causes review fatigue, so deterministic rules and conservative classifiers should handle routine calls and escalate only ambiguous or dangerous ones.
73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.speaker: John Feminella

871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.section: ### 00:00:00 — The Economics of Frontier Labs vs. Open Foundations
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.quote: The problem is, though, that the models have begun to commoditize.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.claim: Frontier models are becoming interchangeable, so the margin labs need to recoup hundreds of billions in spend is narrowing.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.speaker: Dillon Rolnick

871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.section: ### 00:00:00 — The Economics of Frontier Labs vs. Open Foundations
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.quote: And that's exactly how they view the financial industry as a problem to be solved.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.claim: Rather than sell intelligence at shrinking margins, labs will point their models at lucrative domains like finance and compete with their customers directly.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.speaker: Dillon Rolnick

871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.section: ### 00:00:00 — The Economics of Frontier Labs vs. Open Foundations
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.quote: If you're in front of the user, you have an opportunity for stickiness. Stickiness means margin. This is why the fight has largely shifted to the agent layer lately.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.claim: Labs are moving up to the agent layer and embedding in businesses because owning the user relationship creates lock-in and margin.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.speaker: Dillon Rolnick

871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.quote: I implore you: Do not build on quicksand foundations. Build on open foundations.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.claim: Whatever platform a company roots its agentic processes in will harden into its organization, so it should choose an open foundation it controls.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.speaker: Dillon Rolnick

871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.quote: The most of yesterday were in proprietary IP. The modes of tomorrow are in network effects, reputation, and reliability.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.claim: Proprietary software is no longer a moat because agents can reproduce features quickly, so durable advantage moves to network effects, reputation and reliability.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.speaker: Dillon Rolnick

871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.quote: Agents are like operating systems, and they're like frameworks, and they're a lot more like those than they are like chatbots.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.claim: Agents are systems combining deterministic code, data and model judgment, so companies should own that stack, swap models freely and inherit improvements rather than rebuild them.
871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.speaker: Dillon Rolnick

8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.section: ### 00:00:00 — Why Agentic Payments Matter for Tool Marketplaces
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.quote: And on MPP, only like one point five thousand dollars. I mean, it's basically nothing. It's like non-existent.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.claim: Real transaction volume on the leading agent payment protocols is negligible despite more than a year of availability.

8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.claim: Agent payment protocols lose to pre-provisioned accounts and API keys paid by credit card because those are more convenient.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.speaker: Jan Curn

8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.quote: This is crazy because then the agents have no incentives whatsoever. To, you know, to look for existing services because they can build anything from scratch because it costs nothing.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.claim: Subsidized flat-rate model plans remove agents' incentive to buy services instead of building from scratch, and their end would boost demand.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.speaker: Jan Curn

8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.quote: I would say at every step of this funnel, we have some friction points that ultimately, like. Lead to the fact that like agents aren't buying at the end of the funnel.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.claim: The bottleneck is demand, and friction at each funnel stage from need through setup and discovery keeps agents from buying.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.speaker: Jan Curn

8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.section: ### 00:13:38 — Real-World Agent Monetization Lessons at Apify
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.quote: Or basically using trusted directories and marketplaces, and we can already see this happening.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.claim: Agents will discover trustworthy paid services through networks of trust and curated directories and marketplaces.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.speaker: Jan Curn

8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.section: ### 00:13:38 — Real-World Agent Monetization Lessons at Apify
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.quote: But to complete a real job, you actually need like paper use.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.claim: Fixed price per call is insufficient; agent payments need variable pay-per-use billing, which early protocols handled poorly.
8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.speaker: Jan Curn

8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.section: ### 00:00:05 — Why Every Agent Framework Converges on Sandboxed Computers
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.quote: But under the hood, all of these ways speak the three same lines, so it's. Sandbox creation, running some code or task inside the sandbox, and sandbox deletion.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.claim: Competing agent frameworks disagree on what an agent even is, yet all integrate sandboxes through the same create, run, delete primitives, which signals necessity rather than fashion.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.speaker: Mislav Ivanda

8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.section: ### 00:00:05 — Why Every Agent Framework Converges on Sandboxed Computers
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.quote: you essentially defined what. Your model should use, but you didn't define what your model can actually use
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.claim: Command allow-lists and approval prompts on a local machine do not bound what a compromised model can do, since one allowed interpreter command opens everything.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.speaker: Mislav Ivanda

8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.quote: And you can notice that they are not. Adding sandboxes, they already had them, but they are deleting all the alternatives.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.claim: Frameworks are retiring local code executors in favor of a separate VM sandbox, which contains a compromised step so the sandbox can be thrown away and replaced.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.speaker: Mislav Ivanda

8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.quote: These tools that your agent will call inside that runtime will actually run on your device outside that runtime.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.claim: Embedded runtimes like V8 or QuickJS isolate generated code but not the tools it calls, so a malicious agent can still act through those tools on the host.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.speaker: Mislav Ivanda

8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.section: ### 00:10:20 — Patterns from Integrating Across Agent Harnesses
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.quote: Out of this talk is, framers our opinions and the boundary the commitment.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.claim: The execution boundary cannot be swapped later because it shapes how every tool is written, so teams should choose a proper sandboxed computer before choosing a framework rather than carrying a local POC into production.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.speaker: Mislav Ivanda

8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.section: ### 00:10:20 — Patterns from Integrating Across Agent Harnesses
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.quote: And based on this whole story, I think this is essentially the wrong question.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.claim: Asking which framework to pick is the wrong question because models, prompts, features, and even sandbox providers are swappable.
8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.speaker: Mislav Ivanda

9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.section: ### 00:00:00 — Investment Thesis: Modeling the Hedge Fund as a Function
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.quote: Every single thing that a human can see in pixels on the screen. An agent in your building should be able to see via API.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.claim: Agents need direct API access to every data source humans see, or their intelligence is wasted.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.speaker: Frank Long

9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.section: ### 00:00:00 — Investment Thesis: Modeling the Hedge Fund as a Function
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.quote: I think that agents will have an even bigger impact in investing than they did at coding.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.claim: Agents will transform investing even more than they have transformed coding.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.speaker: Frank Long

9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.section: ### 00:00:00 — Investment Thesis: Modeling the Hedge Fund as a Function
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.quote: So at a high level, you can think about a hedge fund as a function that takes in two parameters.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.claim: A hedge fund can be modeled as a function compressing external and internal context into a what/how much/when decision.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.speaker: Frank Long

9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.section: ### 00:04:30 — Deploying Agents Across Public & Private Market Research
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.quote: There's actually a lot of knobs here, and I almost think about those knobs. It's like hyperparameters in a traditional machine learning system, right?
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.claim: Every design choice in even a simple news-ingestion step is a hyperparameter to tune and optimize.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.speaker: Frank Long

9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.section: ### 00:04:30 — Deploying Agents Across Public & Private Market Research
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.quote: There is no glory in automating things for the sake of automating things. The goal is not to take as many things and make them LLMs as possible.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.claim: Each step should be assigned whichever runner (deterministic code, statistics, LLM, or human) maximizes quality, not automated by default.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.speaker: Frank Long

9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.quote: And if you don't have a north star to help climb against. You're just kind of you're just fidgeting around.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.claim: Pipelines must be compartmentalized into evaluable pieces with a clear metric, or tuning becomes aimless.
9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.speaker: Frank Long

a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.section: ### 00:00:00 — From Structured Time Series to Unstructured Data at Bridgewater
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.quote: it takes great data and the right connectors to make AI powerful.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.claim: A generic web-searching chat agent answered an investment question from one stale source, while the same query against Vault found 52 time-scoped candidates and drew on seven, showing data and connectors matter more than the model.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.speaker: Sam Green

a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.section: ### 00:00:00 — From Structured Time Series to Unstructured Data at Bridgewater
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.quote: all that data is not just dumped on our investors' desks. It is carefully aligned to our internal ontology.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.claim: Unstructured data at Bridgewater gets the same cleaning, governance and alignment to the firm's ontology (countries, markets, time period) that its structured time-series data always had.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.speaker: Sam Green

a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.section: ### 00:04:53 — Inside Vault: Architecture for Investment Research
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.quote: The key metric we were looking at is precision at ten, which is of the top ten results, how many are the right documents.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.claim: A hand-built benchmark of about 200 questions confirmed users' complaint that search was bad (about 60% precision at ten) and gave the team a way to measure fixes up to about 95%.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.speaker: Aaron Linsky

a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.section: ### 00:04:53 — Inside Vault: Architecture for Investment Research
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.quote: Their approach, which they call native filtering, looks only in the nearest clusters if it can matches, and then scores just those.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.claim: Production queries almost always carry date, source or asset filters, so they moved to a vector store with native filtering to get post-filtering speed with near pre-filtering recall at agent scale.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.speaker: Aaron Linsky

a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.quote: No matter how amazing the tools are, we can't just drop them on our investors' desks and expect them to be used.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.claim: Adoption required migrating researchers' email habits into Vault, turning subscriber lists into saved searches and folders into saved collections before opening new workflows.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.speaker: Aaron Linsky

a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.quote: the vault enables compounding because it provides the right evidence, the right internal and external information at the fingertips of our investors and agents
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.claim: The goal is proactive always-on agents in an investor workbench, with the synthesis from human-agent collaboration captured back into Vault so the research loop compounds.
a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.speaker: Sam Green

af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.section: ### 00:00:00 — Ten Years of Generative Media & World Models at Runway
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.quote: I think we believe in scaling loss. Not only applied for language models, but also for video, and this has been true.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.claim: Runway bets that scaling laws hold for video models just as they do for language models, and is ramping compute accordingly.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.speaker: Cristóbal Valenzuela

af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.section: ### 00:00:00 — Ten Years of Generative Media & World Models at Runway
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.quote: You're learning about physics. You're learning about object permanence.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.claim: Predicting the next frame at scale forces a model to learn physics, object permanence, gravity and occlusion rather than just pretty pixels.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.speaker: Cristóbal Valenzuela

af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.section: ### 00:05:41 — From Video Generation to Real-Time World Simulation
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.quote: Now everything you just saw here has no physical 3D representation. There's no Unity. There's no Unreal. There's no Blender.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.claim: A 'world interface model' trained on clicks and actions can render a fully interactive interface from an image with no underlying 3D engine, pointing toward an operating system (Continuum) streamed from a model.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.speaker: Cristóbal Valenzuela

af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.section: ### 00:05:41 — From Video Generation to Real-Time World Simulation
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.quote: No physics laws we didn't describe. What did he do? The model just knows how to do that by pure force of scale.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.claim: Applied to 3D-like environments, next-frame prediction approaches a physics engine without any hand-written physics rules, purely through scale.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.speaker: Cristóbal Valenzuela

af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.section: ### 00:05:41 — From Video Generation to Real-Time World Simulation
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.quote: At any point in time, in that prediction, which means I can simulate any possible divergence or action in that world.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.claim: Making video models real-time and actionable at every frame turns them into simulators of any possible action or divergence, useful for robotics as well as media.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.speaker: Cristóbal Valenzuela

af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.quote: Agents have the ability to do visual thinking. Agents can spin up. A sort of imagination that you can tap and interact with
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.claim: Connecting a real-time world model to a coding agent gives it 'visual thinking': a shared imagination the human can see and use to guide the agent better than text alone.
af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.speaker: Cristóbal Valenzuela

b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.section: ### 00:00:00 — The Evolving Role of the AI Engineer
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.quote: How do you set up your telemetry data so that agents are the primary consumers of that data?
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.claim: Telemetry should be designed for agents as its primary readers, so observability data becomes the trigger that wakes always-on agents.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.speaker: Aparna Dhinakaran

b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.section: ### 00:00:00 — The Evolving Role of the AI Engineer
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.quote: As an AI engineer, your job is no longer to just write the feature, write a bad feature. It's about how do you build the loop.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.claim: The AI engineer is now responsible for building the system that does build, eval, ship, monitor and improve, not for doing each step by hand.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.speaker: Aparna Dhinakaran

b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.quote: we built Signal to also be. You know, agnostic of the model or the harness.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.claim: Making the agent harness- and model-agnostic lets the team compare quality across models and cut cost without losing rigor.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.speaker: Aparna Dhinakaran

b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.quote: All of the output is actually saved off in some kind of memory, so that the next time an agent gets spun up, it doesn't have to start from ground zero.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.claim: Each Signal run uses a disposable sandbox behind a single proxy, while issues, traces and learned skills persist outside it so runs are durable and resumable.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.speaker: Aparna Dhinakaran

b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.quote: Verify them against the human output, and then try to align to make sure that the judge actually agrees with the human.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.claim: Engineers should spend their time defining what good is, building golden datasets and evaluating the evaluators until LLM judges agree with human judgment before shipping them.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.speaker: Aparna Dhinakaran

b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.quote: tracing everything now means not just. Tracing the agents, but also tracing the coding agents behind the agents that build this.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.claim: Tracing must extend to the coding agents that build the product, and online evals on that telemetry feed back into the agents that find problems.
b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.speaker: Aparna Dhinakaran

b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.section: ### 00:00:00 — What Is Exa & Agentic Web Search
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.quote: All of the search results, which means that you can actually get higher quality results. At ninety-five percent fewer tokens than you would at full-page text.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.claim: Search cost should be measured over the agent's whole trajectory, and returning only the relevant snippets cuts downstream input tokens dramatically.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.speaker: Ryan Ahern

b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.section: ### 00:00:00 — What Is Exa & Agentic Web Search
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.quote: They tend to describe what they want to search in great detail, execute many searches, and want to understand the space.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.claim: Agents search differently from humans, issuing many detailed queries, so search must be built for agent consumption.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.speaker: Ryan Ahern

b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.section: ### 00:06:00 — Exa Snapshot & Backtesting Financial Agents Without Lookahead Bias
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.quote: It's 400 billion plus snapshots of the web, and you can search them by day.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.claim: Because Exa's crawler versions every page it checks for freshness, it can serve a URL or run a whole search as it would have looked on a past date.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.speaker: Ryan Ahern

b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.section: ### 00:06:00 — Exa Snapshot & Backtesting Financial Agents Without Lookahead Bias
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.quote: In this case, if you do a live search, you're going to find like that the deal was announced, right?
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.claim: Testing a prediction agent on the live web leaks the outcome, so point-in-time search is needed to evaluate what it could have known before the event.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.speaker: Ryan Ahern

b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.quote: Detect these things, but you've also got to check that it generalizes.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.claim: Snapshot lets teams check that a search feature generalizes rather than overfits, without waiting months for live results.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.speaker: Ryan Ahern

b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.quote: You can actually go back and back test that against your existing processes and say.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.claim: Teams can backtest whether adding agentic web features such as adverse media scans to existing models actually improves them, instead of taking it on faith.
b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.speaker: Ryan Ahern

bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.section: ### 00:00:00 — Code Review at Scale: Signal vs. Noise
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.quote: Now the first thing that's going to go wrong is you're going to miss bugs.
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.claim: A simple sandboxed agent wired to pull requests will miss bugs, misunderstand the codebase, cost several dollars per review and flood developers with nitpicks.
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.speaker: Daksh Gupta

bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.section: ### 00:05:48 — Iterative Architecture of Greptile's Review Agent
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.quote: If you use hard code to write the code, you want to use the GPT model to review it.
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.claim: Models fail the same way when reviewing as when generating, so the reviewer should be a different model family than the one that wrote the code.
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.speaker: Daksh Gupta

bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.section: ### 00:05:48 — Iterative Architecture of Greptile's Review Agent
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.quote: The validation against really any reviewer can tell you about the presence of bugs, but unfortunately can't tell you about the absence of bugs.
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.claim: Because catastrophic bugs are rare, prompt changes must be evaluated against a catalog of historical bug-causing changes rather than judged by comment volume.
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.speaker: Daksh Gupta

bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.quote: In practice, we have actually twenty different subtasks, and each of them has a very specific sense model to be used.
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.claim: Reserving frontier models for critical steps and routing the long tail of subtasks to small models cuts review cost drastically, provided an eval set guards against regressions.
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.speaker: Daksh Gupta
also_at: ### 00:00:00 — Code Review at Scale: Signal vs. Noise

bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.quote: Is we essentially build these dependency-rich sandboxes, which are completely configurable virtual machines.
bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.claim: Spinning up the customer's full stack in a sandbox and driving it with computer-use models catches issues, like UI regressions, that reading the diff cannot.

edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.section: ### 00:00:00 — Why 'Done' Is Not Enough for Production Agents
edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.quote: But that takes a long time and these agents can write code a lot faster than us, so we don't want to rely on that.
edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.claim: Line-by-line human code review cannot keep pace with how fast agents generate code, so trust has to come from another mechanism.

edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.quote: Don't just tell me yeah, passes. It looks good because there's nothing to back that up, I need actual screenshots, videos, test results, smoke tests.
edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.claim: An agent's claim of being done counts only when backed by tangible evidence such as screenshots, recordings, and test results.

edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.quote: So that you can just run that over and over, and it's doing more of a deterministic check.
edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.claim: Encoding verification as runnable scripts rather than vague prompt instructions gives agents a deterministic, repeatable check whose output they can use to self-correct.

edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.quote: When you want that, if you have all those verifiers in place, then your software doesn't matter as much.
edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.claim: The verification harness becomes more valuable than the application code itself, because with verifiers in place the software can be rewritten and re-proven.

edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.quote: It's more about giving it the map, saying you must get here. You'll know you're here when this command returns to us.
edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.claim: Agents should be given a verifiable outcome rather than a prescribed path, since constraints on the goal leave room for creative solutions.
edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.speaker: Zack Proser

fca86857-d079-46a6-94a7-62b0bb8e5d31.section: ### 00:00:00 — Why Live LLM Serving & Benchmarking Is Hard

fca86857-d079-46a6-94a7-62b0bb8e5d31.section: ### 00:05:15 — Serving Open Models with vLLM on Runpod
